area: the Profile's colour-set rail, the analytics console and editor themes, the style-guide tokens, and the skills
summary: Dart Frog, Nacre, Contrast and the five vision sets have new pigments and Nocturne's Gold rim moved 4 degrees, so the catalog asset's words (Dart Frog's and Nacre's lines, the pigments of Dart Frog, Nacre and Contrast), themes.css / theme.js, FrogletSeaTheme.Themes.cs and froglet-tokens.json (gold #FF8F11 to #FF9B11) were regenerated; make_themes.py's self-test now reads Dart Frog's bronze from colour_sets.json instead of pinning #774325; and a new skill, /colour-set, with its tool Tools/Build/colour_set_maker.py.
why: Garrett asked for colour-set rules that keep the six domains distinguishable and each looking like its name, Dart Frog and Nacre fixed under them, and a skill that makes sets from any inspiration. Nacre's UI theme is now mint-hued (its Jade face is seafoam, was lavender); Dart Frog's stays bronze.
